senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to drive an animal,] to lead, conduct; to demean one’s self; to be guided by, be wont to; to apply, be practiced.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 103b:22">Keth. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>נְהוֹג</he>, v. <cite ref="D00897"><he>דָּמִים</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 7:1">Ḥull. VII, 1</cite> <cite ref="N00318"><he>נוֹהֵג</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="C00626"><he>גִּיד</he></cite>. Sifra Tsav, Par. 11, ch. XVIII <he>שיִנְהוֹג הדבר לדורות</he> which intimates that this order should be preserved at all times.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 4:1">Pes. IV, 1</cite> <he>מקום שנָהֲגוּ וכ׳</he> where it is a local usage to &c.
<cite ref="Megillah 6b:15">Meg. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>כל מצות שנוֹהֲגוֹת בשני וכ׳</he> all laws that apply to the second (Adar) apply also to the first.

<cite ref="Megillah 5b:11">Ib. 5ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>דברים … ואחרים נָהֲגוּ בהן איסור</he> things which are permitted, but which some treat as forbidden; a. v. fr.—<he>נ׳ כבוד</he>, v. <cite ref="K00037"><he>כָּבוֹד</he></cite>.—(<he>ראש</he>) <he>נ׳ קלות</he>, v. <cite ref="S01300"><he>קַלּוּת</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 54b:3-14">Ab. Zar. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>עולם … נוהג</he>, v. <cite ref="M01727"><he>מִנְהָג</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 764:4">Yalk. Num. 764</cite> <he>נ׳ שמנים וכ׳</he> he applied oils and baths.

senses.gloss: to drive, direct; to take possession of an animal by driving.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 8:2">Kil. VIII, 2</cite> <he>להַנְהִיג</he>, v. <cite ref="M02892"><he>מָשַׁךְ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 8:3">Ib. 3</cite> <he>המַנְהִיג</he> the driver of heterogeneous animals.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:2">B. Mets. I, 2</cite> <he>אחד רוכב ואחד מנהיג</he> one rode (the animal that was found), and the other directed it (by leading).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 8b:3">Ib. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>רכוב במקום מנהיג</he> the rights of the driver as against those of the leader.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 8b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>במנהיג ברגליו</he> when the rider drives by means of his heels.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 8b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>תרי גווני מנהיג</he> there are two ways of driving; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:1">B. Bath. V, 1</cite> <he>ואת כל המַנְהִיגִין אותה</he> and all the implements needed for directing the ship; a. e., v. <cite ref="M01730"><he>מַנְהִיג</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 35b:6">Ber. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>הַנְהֵג בהן דרך ארץ</he> combine with the study of the Law a secular occupation; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 863">Yalk. Deut. 863</cite> <he>תּנְהוֹג</he>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 92a:6">Snh. 92ᵃ</cite> <he>כל פרנס שמנהיג … ומַנְהִיגָם וכ׳</he> a manager that leads a community with gentleness, will be privileged to lead it in the days to come (of resurrection); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 2:15">Tosef. Bets. II, 15</cite> <he>ה׳ את בני רומי וכ׳</he> made it a custom among the Jews in Rome &c.—<he>ה׳ עצמו ברבנות</he> to assume airs of superiority.
<cite ref="Sotah 13b">Sot. 13ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 323:1">Sifré Deut. 323</cite> <he>הִתְנַהֲגוּ זה את זה וכ׳</he> conduct yourselves towards one another in charity; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be conducted. Y. B. Kam. VI, 5ᶜ top רוח שהעולם מִתְנַהֵג בו a wind by which the world is maintained, i.e. an ordinary wind, opp. של אונסים a calamitous wind (Bab.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 60a">ib. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>רוח מצויה</he>, v. <cite ref="M02262"><he>מָצָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 66:2">Gen. R. s. 66</cite> <he>מתנהג בה וכ׳</he> moves with her (Israel) from tent to tent.—V. <cite ref="N00318"><he>נוֹהַג</he></cite>.
